input.code:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('sales.csv')

# Display the first few rows to understand the structure
print('Data structure:')
print(df.head())
print('\nColumns:', df.columns.tolist())
print('\nShape:', df.shape)

# Calculate total revenue per region
revenue_by_region = df.groupby('region')['revenue'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)

print('\nTotal revenue per region:')
print(revenue_by_region)

# Create bar chart
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
revenue_by_region.plot(kind='bar', color='steelblue')
plt.title('Total Revenue by Region')
plt.xlabel('Region')
plt.ylabel('Revenue')
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('chart.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
print('\nChart saved as chart.png')

# Get the region with highest revenue
top_region = revenue_by_region.index[0]
top_revenue = revenue_by_region.iloc[0]

# Create the report
report = f'# Revenue Report\n\nThe region with the highest total revenue is {top_region} with ${top_revenue:,.2f}. This represents the strongest performing region in our current portfolio.\n'

# Save the report
with open('report.md', 'w') as f:
    f.write(report)

print(f'\nReport saved as report.md')
print(f'Top region: {top_region} with revenue: ${top_revenue:,.2f}')
